The fourth edition of my "A Day in the Life of..." series is here!

This series revisits characters from my main comics to see what sexy scenarios they've gotten into since the conclusion of their main stories. This time around we're revisiting Nikki from New Management!

If you enjoy my work you can support me on SubscribeStar to view all of my comics and series 2 releases early! That's about 2-4 months of early access! Members also vote on the "A Day in the Life of..." series to choose what characters/scenarios we revisit from previous comics!
